item.title: 4 Revenue Levers
item.description: If you want your business to make more money, there are only 4 ways to go about it: Make more people buy. Make people buy more often. Make people buy more per transaction. Raise your prices. Every revenue strategy boils down to pulling one or more of these levers.

item.title: 3 Levels of Strategy
item.description: Strategy is "the skill of making or carrying out plans to achieve a goal". But this definition rests on assumptions: that we have a known goal, that we know where we are now, and that we know who we are. Three levels of strategy address these different depths of understanding.

item.title: 3 Circles of Customer Value
item.description: Imagine you own a small restaurant and a guy walks in for soup. There are 3 horizons to think about his value: the profit from this transaction, the lifetime value if he returns, and the network value if he brings others. Three expanding circles of customer value.
